description: Push sales orders fulfilled OUTSIDE Spark for an External warehouse. They feed demand velocity without touching on-hand (the snapshot stays the inventory authority). Idempotent: each order is keyed by its stable externalOrderId — re-pushing the same id is a no-op.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

orders.description: Orders: externalOrderId (stable dedup key), customer fields, lines (identifier/quantity/price).

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured resolution preview (matched/unmatched identifiers, already-pushed order ids) plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is written until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

name: push_external_sales_orders
title: Push External Sales Orders
